startUrls.title: Listing URLs
startUrls.description: SeLoger listing detail pages to scrape, e.g. https://www.seloger.com/annonces/achat/appartement/bayeux-14/268652599.htm

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: SeLoger is protected by DataDome. Residential proxies are strongly recommended — datacenter IPs get challenged within a handful of requests.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Keep this low. SeLoger flags bursts of parallel requests from the same subnet.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max retries per URL
maxRequestRetries.description: Each retry gets a fresh proxy IP and browser fingerprint.

headless.title: Run headless
headless.description: Turn off only when debugging locally.
